nav.label: Main navigation
onb.title: Welcome to Auralis
onb.welcome.title: Welcome to Auralis
onb.welcome.text: A per-app audio mixer, voice changer and voice test studio for Windows. Everything runs locally on this PC.
onb.language.title: Language and theme
onb.language.text: Choose how Auralis looks and reads. You can change this later in Settings.
onb.output.title: Output device
onb.output.text: Auralis uses your Windows default playback device unless you pick another one for a specific app.
onb.mic.title: Test your microphone
onb.mic.text: Speak normally. The meter below shows the level Auralis receives from your default microphone. Nothing is recorded.
onb.mic.nolevel: No signal yet. Check that the right microphone is the Windows default.
onb.safety.title: Safety first
onb.safety.text: Live monitoring plays your voice through your output device. Use headphones so the sound cannot loop back into the microphone.
onb.safety.warn: With speakers, monitoring can cause loud feedback. Start with a low volume. An emergency stop is always available.
onb.virtual.title: Virtual microphone
onb.virtual.text: To use the changed voice in other apps, a virtual audio cable driver is needed. Auralis never installs drivers on its own and works fine without one.
onb.hotkeys.title: Global hotkeys
onb.hotkeys.text: These shortcuts work even when Auralis is in the background. You can change them on the Hotkeys page.
onb.done.title: You are all set
onb.done.text: Open the Voice Test page to try your voice with headphones, or explore the mixer.
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your audio setup
dashboard.nothingPlaying: No app is playing audio right now.
mixer.subtitle: Control the volume of every app and your output device
mixer.soloActive: Solo is on: other apps are muted
mixer.emptyHint: Apps appear here as soon as they start playing or open an audio session.
mic.subtitle: Microphone selection, level and gain
mic.noneHint: Plug in a microphone or enable it in Windows sound settings.
mic.levelDefaultOnly: The live level meter follows the Windows default microphone.
mic.processingHint: Gain applied inside Auralis only. It does not change the Windows microphone volume.
voiceTest.title: Voice Test Studio
voiceTest.subtitle: Hear your voice live with headphones, record a short test and compare presets
voiceTest.feedbackDetected: Possible feedback detected. Lower the volume or use headphones.
voiceTest.dspNote: Latency is the measured software buffer path. Acoustic and device latency are not included.
voiceTest.recordPrivacy: Recordings stay in memory on this PC. Nothing is saved or uploaded unless you export it.
voiceTest.tryPresetsHint: Play the same take through any preset to compare them.
voiceChanger.subtitle: Choose a preset, then fine-tune every module
voiceChanger.previewHint: Changes are applied live while monitoring is running.
voiceChanger.eqHint: Shape the tone on the Equalizer page.
voiceChanger.pitchLatency: Pitch shifting adds a small extra delay.
eq.subtitle: Three-band equalizer for your voice
eq.hint: Drag the points or use the sliders below.
devices.subtitle: Playback and recording devices detected by Windows
devices.virtualHint: Auralis detects installed virtual audio cables but does not install drivers by itself. The status shows detection only, not an active connection.
routing.subtitle: Send individual apps to a specific output device
routing.unsupported: Per-app routing is not supported on this version of Windows.
routing.note: Routing uses the Windows per-app audio policy. Some apps only apply a change after they restart their audio.
profiles.subtitle: Save and restore your voice setup
profiles.saveCurrent: Save current setup as a profile
profiles.includes: A profile stores the voice preset, module settings and equalizer.
profiles.emptyHint: Save your current voice setup above to create one.
profiles.importNote: Imported files are validated before they are added.
hotkeys.subtitle: Global shortcuts that work in any app
hotkeys.needModifier: Use at least one modifier key (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) or a function key.
hotkeys.note: Shortcuts already used by another app cannot be registered. Press Esc while recording to cancel.
diag.subtitle: System status, logs and troubleshooting tools
diag.privacy: Logs never contain audio. Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.subtitle: Appearance, startup and behavior
settings.closeToTrayHint: Keeps Auralis running in the background when you close the window.
settings.feedbackWarningHint: Warn when monitoring may be looping into the microphone.
settings.showAdvancedHint: Reveals attack, hold and release controls.
settings.privacyText: Auralis has no telemetry, no accounts and no cloud features. Audio is never recorded unless you start a test recording, and it stays in memory.
about.tagline: Audio mixer, voice changer and voice test studio
about.privacy: Auralis runs entirely on your PC. It never records in the background and never sends audio or usage data anywhere.
preset.natural.name: Natural
preset.natural.desc: No processing. Your voice exactly as captured.
preset.clean-mic.name: Clean Mic
preset.clean-mic.desc: Noise suppression, gate, high-pass, gentle presence and compression.
preset.podcast.name: Podcast
preset.podcast.desc: Warm low end, tight dynamics and broadcast-style presence.
preset.deep.name: Deep Voice
preset.deep.desc: Lower pitch with a longer vocal tract for a larger voice.
preset.bright.name: Bright Voice
preset.bright.desc: Higher pitch with a smaller vocal tract.
preset.chipmunk.name: Chipmunk
preset.giant.name: Giant
preset.ranger.name: Ranger
preset.ranger.desc: Tight, gritty mid-range with a touch of drive.
preset.radio.name: Radio
preset.radio.desc: Narrow band, compressed and lightly distorted.
preset.telephone.name: Telephone
preset.walkie.name: Walkie-Talkie
preset.monster.name: Monster
preset.robot.name: Robot
preset.robot.desc: Metallic ring modulation with a slight wobble.
preset.ethereal.name: Ethereal
preset.ethereal.desc: Airy, shimmering voice with a long tail.
preset.cathedral.name: Cathedral
preset.echo.name: Echo
preset.anonymous.name: Anonymous
preset.anonymous.desc: Altered pitch and timbre to mask a voice for privacy.
preset.female-ish.name: Higher Tone
preset.male-ish.name: Lower Tone
preset.streamer.name: Streamer
preset.streamer.desc: Loud, clear and consistent for live streaming.
note.local: Audio is processed locally. Nothing is uploaded and raw audio is never logged.
note.latency: Latency shown in the Voice Test is the measured buffer path, not the acoustic round trip.
note.routing: Per-application output routing is not supported by this Windows build.
